entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Section 374(4) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.846 of 2022(4) dt.21-04-2023 mandates expeditious hearing of the appeals arising out of conviction under Sections 376, 376(A), 376(AB), 376(B), 376(C), 376(D),
376(DA), 376(DB) or 376 (E) of the Indian Penal Code.
The said provision further requires that such appeal should be disposed of within a period of six months from the date of filing of such appeal.

In such view of the matter, instead of considering the appellant's prayer for his release on bail during the pendency of the appeal, it is considered desirable, keeping in mind the statutory prescription envisioned under Section 374(4) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, to expedite hearing Ajay Prasad vs The State Of Bihar on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145053391/
1 of the appeal itself.
